heroKicker: Digitalisation & AI for small businesses · Madrid
heroSub: I help small and micro businesses modernise: digitalising the way they work, bringing in artificial intelligence where it truly adds value, and making sure that when someone asks an AI about what you offer, your business is among its recommendations. And if you want to grow, I guide you step by step so you never build the roof before the foundations.
credText1: I have created, scaled and run digital products — I know which steps come first and which can wait
credText2: Owner of enterprise AI & ML platforms at BASF Digital Solutions
credText3: PhD Computer Science · MSc Artificial Intelligence
credText4: Co-founder of a live B2B platform — I know what it takes to make technology work in a real business
methodTitle: Three steps to modernise your business in the right order
methodIntro: Technology works when it comes in the right order. First we understand your business and lay solid foundations; then we add AI where it brings real value; and finally we make sure both your customers and AI assistants can find you.
v1Text: We digitalise what is holding you back today: a clear website, customer and sales data in order, and simple tools for your team's day-to-day work. Affordable, right-sized and left in your hands.
v1Sig1: Information scattered across emails, paper and spreadsheets
v1Sig2: Repetitive manual tasks that eat up hours every week
v1Sig3: A website that is outdated, slow or hard to update
v2Title: Add AI where it pays off
v2Text: The AI that pays off most in a small business doesn't talk to your customers: it works behind the scenes. It reads invoices and orders, prepares drafts your team reviews and anticipates sales and stock. We only bring it in when it saves time or money, and in a way your team can manage without depending on anyone.
v2Sig1: Data typed by hand from one document to another
v2Sig2: Hours spent writing quotes, emails or reports
v2Sig3: Purchasing and stock decided by gut feeling
v3Text: More and more people ask ChatGPT, Gemini or Perplexity before searching on Google. We make your business information clear, consistent and easy for these systems to interpret, so they have good reasons to recommend you. No one can guarantee a recommendation, but a great deal can be done to earn one.
v3Sig1: AI assistants don't mention you, or get your details wrong
v3Sig2: Incomplete or outdated information on Google and directories
v3Sig3: A website that doesn't answer what your customers ask
kpiList: How customers and AI assistants find you today · website and Google Business Profile · manual and repetitive processes · state of your data · the tools you pay for and the ones you actually use · reviews and reputation · data protection and security · budget and team capacity · growth goals.
servicesTitle: Useful technology, clearly explained and in the right order
svc1Text: We review how your business works today and how customers and AI assistants find you. You receive a clear report: what to fix first, what can wait and what it will cost in time and money.
svc2Text: We replace paper, scattered spreadsheets and repetitive tasks with simple tools: customer management, bookings, invoicing, automations. Chosen for your size and budget, and set up so your team actually uses them.
svc3Text: Automatic reading of invoices and orders, drafts of quotes and emails that your team reviews, sales and stock forecasts, and a guide to using AI safely day to day. We start with one concrete case, measure the result and only then expand.
svc4Text: We prepare your website, Google profile, directories and content so that ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and search engines understand what you offer, where and for whom — and can recommend you when someone needs it.
svc5Text: A fast, clear website that explains what you do, designed to turn visits into enquiries and to be understood by people and machines alike. Easy to update without depending on anyone.
svc6Title: Growing with technology, step by step
svc6Text: A new business line, another market, an online shop or more locations? We map out the roadmap: what to set up first, what to buy and when, and which indicators will tell you it is working — so growth rests on solid ground.
audIntro: My focus is small and micro businesses: little time, a tight budget and plenty to do. Whatever your sector, if you want to modernise or grow with technology, I can help you do it well.
aud1Text: You are sales, admin and customer service all at once. We free up your time with a few well-chosen tools and make sure your customers can find you.
aud2Text: Years of habits, files and tools that no longer fit. We bring order, modernise what matters most and prepare the business for its next stage.
aud3Text: Shops, restaurants, clinics, workshops, practices, agencies… When someone asks an AI about what you do, your business should be part of the answer.
aud4Text: A new location, another market, an online channel or a new service. I guide you through the technology steps, in the right order, so you grow without improvising.
eng1Text: One day, remote or on site, to review your digital situation and how AI assistants see your business. You leave with a written report and a prioritised list of actions.
eng2Text: A few weeks to put the plan into practice: digital foundations, first automations or AI use cases and visibility improvements — together with your team, training included.
eng3Text: Close follow-up as your business grows: new tools, new uses of AI and a regular review of results — usually two to four days a month.
engFact1: Two to four days a month, so each project gets the attention it deserves
engFact3: Based in Madrid, working remotely across Europe
pr1Text: Adding technology on top of disorder only multiplies the disorder. First we sort out the essentials, then we build on them.
pr2Title: AI only when it adds value
pr2Text: Sometimes the best answer is a simple tool, and I will tell you so. I recommend AI when it saves time or money, never to follow a trend.
pr3Text: I explain every step in plain language and document everything so your team understands it and can run it. My goal is that you never depend on me.
aboutText1: I'm Aarón Ayllón Benítez, a PhD in Computer Science and an advisor in technology and artificial intelligence. I enjoy helping small businesses get the most out of technology in a practical, honest way — without jargon or unnecessary spending.
aboutText2: I have owned enterprise AI platforms, built products from scratch and co-founded a B2B platform. I put that experience at the service of small and micro businesses, translated into concrete steps you can understand, apply and maintain.
contactText: Tell me where you are: a business that needs bringing up to date, a process that eats up your time, a plan to grow or simply the question of what AI could do for you. I will reply within two working days and, if I'm not the right person, I'll tell you honestly.
fMsg: Tell me what you would like to improve
fNote: Opens your mail client with the message filled in.
workTitle: I don't just advise: I build too
workIntro: Some products I have designed and built from start to finish. The same approach I bring to every client: understand the problem well, start with the essentials and leave something that can be maintained.
w1Text: An app for volleyball clubs: teams, players, competitions, referees and club-scoped roles and permissions. It works on your phone like a native app.
w2Text: The match scoresheet, from paper to tablet: it works offline, can be followed live and, once closed, is sent signed to the league as an official PDF and Excel file.
w3Text: A platform that connects businesses with specialised professionals, with quick, secure onboarding that keeps personal data private.
footBrand: Ayllon Tech Advisory (AT Advisory) · Madrid, Spain
d1Note: Nobody types anything: the data goes straight into your accounting software and only what the AI flags as uncertain is reviewed.
m1Msg: Just spoke with Laura Gómez from Reformas Ejemplo: she wants a quote to refurbish 3 offices. Log it in the CRM and remind me to call her on Thursday.
m1Note: The AI understands your message and, through MCP, uses your CRM's tools: it searches, creates and updates records without you leaving the chat.
r1Q: A customer wants to return an online order from 20 days ago. Can they? Who pays for shipping?
r1A1: Yes: they have 30 days from delivery to return it.
r1A2: The customer pays for return shipping, unless the product arrived faulty.
r1Note: The AI answers only from what your documents say (RAG) and cites where it found it, so anyone can check.
